data.one_liner: Installs Android APKs and opens iOS App Store URLs from Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin to programmatically install an APK on Android devices and to launch the App Store on iOS via a URL. Handles required Android permissions and offers simple Dart API calls.
use_when: You need to install an APK downloaded at runtime on Android
You want to redirect users to an iOS App Store page from your app
avoid_when: You rely on official app stores for distribution only
You need a cross‑platform package that also handles updates or store listings
strengths: Supports Android 5‑13 and handles permission nuances
Simple API with install and gotoAppStore functions
Works for both network‑downloaded and local APKs
weaknesses: Only covers APK install and iOS URL launch, no broader store management
Limited to Android/iOS, no web or desktop support
data.setup_notes: Add READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions to AndroidManifest. Ensure iOS project uses Swift. No build_runner needed.
data.minimal_example:
await InstallPlugin.install('/path/to/app.apk'); // Android install
await InstallPlugin.install('https://itunes.apple.com/app/id123456'); // iOS App Store redirect
